critical_code_review_comments: create_appointment: the 2-limit check is not atomic - two concurrent requests could both pass the count check and create a 3rd. Acceptable for low-traffic barber use case but consider a unique-index or transaction if scale increases.
Client upsert only sets name on first creation; if the same phone books later with a different booker_name/client_name, the /api/clients name won't update. Not required by spec but worth noting.
server.py is a single ~490-line file; consider splitting routers (auth/services/appointments/clients) as it grows.
